name: DynaPaste
description: Clipboard history in a full lake. Copy anything and open DynaPaste from the notch to copy it again, paste it, pin it, or delete it. Text, links, images, and files are kept.

settings.title: History Size
settings.description: How many items to keep. Pinned items don't count.

settings.title: Keep Images
settings.description: Save copied images to the history.

settings.title: Ignore Passwords
settings.description: Skip copies that password managers mark as private.

settings.title: Show Copies in the Notch
settings.description: Briefly show what you copied as a live activity.
